Two bakers and a very old oven

Hazel and Rye started in a garage in 2019 with one sourdough starter called Gerald. You can read how Gerald came to live with us on our blog.

What we believe

  • Long, slow fermentation for flavour and digestion.
  • Flour milled within forty miles of the bakery.
  • No additives, ever.

Our oven

The deck oven came from a closing bakery in 2020 and still bakes ninety loaves an hour.
